summary: The Lenovo's install sitting rehearsed in its small form: save, install with the grow, and restore, each judged against the save set; the scenario is tests/cases/machine/installer_rehearse_sitting.c

cases.behavior: the Lenovo's install sitting rehearsed on a disk of 256 MiB: the recovery system saves the save set onto a save disk, the install from the test stick grows the root to the disk's end, the saved ranges are put back with reflash and read back, and neither the install nor the restore writes a sector outside the save set
units: `tests/system/suites/installer.sh` rehearse part, the rehearsal of the install sitting in its small form

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends each boot and removes the overlay and the copies of the save disk and the stick, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the recovery system from the stick and save each range of the target into a file of the save disk
boot again and install from the stick onto the target, growing the root to the disk's end
read the overlay's map with qemu-img and judge it with growset against the save set
boot again, put each saved range back with reflash and write the digests reflash --verify reads into the save disk
read the digests off the save disk, compare them with the saved bytes', and judge the overlay's map again

assertions.checks: the recovery system mounts the save disk and saves every range of the save set onto it, with no read failing
the install from the stick checks the image against its manifest and its readback, writes the table and the accounts, grows the root and says it installed
the overlay's map lists the extents the install wrote
every sector the install and the grow wrote lies in the save set
every saved range is written back with reflash and read back with reflash --verify, with no write failing
each range reads back as the bytes that were saved: its mark and then zeros to its length
the restore writes nothing outside the save set

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case boots the install stick by the firmware and installs onto a disk of its own
